description: Outcomes an interactive (terminal mode) adapter names. They are the terminal subset of agent-protocol.v1.json `results`, plus the wire shape the supervisor uses to record and compare them. An adapter reads what the agent shows and returns one outcome per step; it never opens a tab, picks a model, changes a timeout or retries.

ready.meaning: the CLI shows an empty prompt and can take the brief

blocked.meaning: the CLI waits for something only a person can do; the supervisor stops with a named stop cause and the pane stays (release retain)

delivered.meaning: the brief is confirmed submitted (the CLI shows it working or the composer is empty), not merely visible. Only this outcome lets the supervisor send BRIEF_DELIVERED

delivery-unknown.meaning: submission could not be confirmed; the adapter never resends blind and the supervisor sends no BRIEF_DELIVERED

completed.meaning: the agent finished and the result file exists; the supervisor then types the exit command

needs-human.meaning: the agent asked something only a person can answer in its result or on screen

wire.shape: { "outcome": <name>, ...fields }; one JSON object; `outcome` is exactly one key of `outcomes`
wire.order: ready -> (blocked | delivered | delivery-unknown) -> completed | needs-human; ready is never reported after delivered, and completed only after delivered
wire.usageLimit: usage-limit is a direct-mode blocked reason only; a terminal adapter reports a usage limit as needs-human

mapping.toStop: blocked, needs-human and delivery-unknown end the run early: the supervisor stops the agent through the normal stop path with stop cause `cancel` (stop-requested.v1.json keeps its closed cause list), so gate-exit and the receipt read cancelled
mapping.toReceiptReason: the receipt's optional `reason` carries `terminal:<outcome>` or `terminal:blocked:<reason>` so the settle step and a person can tell why; the pane is released with retain

vectors: packages/agent-protocol/contracts/fixtures/terminal/<cli>/vectors.json, one per CLI; each step expects one `outcome` object of this contract
